title: Dynamic IO Minimums with Grace Credits (Prototype)
creator: Aisha Kumar
description: Problem: Customers are sensitive to asymmetric cost when an app sends many short prompts (high input tokens) that generate long outputs (high output tokens) and vice versa. Current per-direction minimums and flat streaming floors can overcharge or under-incentivize efficient usage. Goal: Prototype a dynamic minimums model that weights billed minimums toward the net economic impact of input vs output tokens for a workload and offers a temporary 'grace credit' during the first 30 days of a customer's usage spike to avoid abrupt invoice shocks. We will focus on hosted API only for the prototype. This ticket captures the PM experiment plan, metrics, and required artifacts for Eng/Console/Sales review.
acceptance_criteria:
- Implementation spec reviewed by Eng and Legal.
- A/B experiment config deployable to two tenant cohorts (control: current symmetric minimum; treatment: dynamic IO minimum + 30-day grace credits).
- Metric dashboards in Grafana/Looker showing per-tenant token distribution (input vs output), effective billed minimums, and invoice deltas.
- No customer-facing bill increases >10% for customers flagged as 'sensitive' during the pilot window.
- Rollback plan and automated alerting if revenue delta or error rate exceed thresholds.
- Experiment code and console UI changes merged behind feature flag.
updates: 2026-02-13: Kickoff with Eng (runtime + billing), Console, Legal, and Sales. Agreed scope limited to hosted API pricing layer and console rollout messaging. Confluence: /pricing/pm/PM-42154-proto.

2026-02-20: Engineering provided initial cost model impact simulation using last-quarter tenant traces (sampled 5k tenants). Simulation found 12% mean revenue uplift among bursty-output workloads and 4% revenue reduction for prolonged high-input workloads. (See attachment: sim-results-0219.csv).

2026-02-24: Design mockups completed for console UX that surfaces 'grace credit' countdown and expected billed minimum changes. Link: Drive/design/PM-42154/grace-credit-ux.png. Design notes: keep messaging non-technical with link to 'how billing works' doc.
2026-02-28: Legal flagged enterprise contract language for 'grace credit' and requested security questionnaire mapping for billing events. Legal action: PR to contracts repo (PR#1342).

2026-03-03: Eng raised concern about streaming telemetry: need per-request input/output token counts at 1-min aggregation to compute rolling 30-day baseline. Added dependency ENG-49821 (billing-metrics-aggregation).
2026-03-05: Experiment config and traffic split proposal drafted. Ready for stakeholder review. Added rollback thresholds: +25% revenue delta or +8% customer complaints trigger rollback.
decisions: Prototype will use a weighted minimum where weight = max(0.5, min(1.5, observed_output_ratio * 0.9 + 0.1)). This keeps extremes bounded.
Grace credit = 100 free minimum-credits applied once per tenant surge window (30-day), visible in console.
Feature gated behind 'dynamic-io-minimums' flag; control group continues current symmetric floor.
next_steps: Convene Review: Legal + Sales + Customer Success on 2026-03-10 to sign off messaging and contract language.
Deliver telemetry contract and assign ENG-49821.
Create A/B cohort selection criteria (exclude customers on committed Dedicated contracts).
Schedule a 2-week canary followed by full 8-week experiment if canary metrics stable.
